title: Weight of the World
description: 《Weight of the World》，选自游戏《尼尔：机械纪元》（NieR: Automata）原声带，冈部启一（MONACA）作曲，本曲为长笛改编版（a 小调，人声升高八度）。旋律在克制与奔涌之间层层推进，从低回的诉说走向释然的合唱，适合练习长乐句的气息铺排与力度层次的表现力。
descriptionEn: "Weight of the World", from the soundtrack of NieR: Automata, composed by Keiichi Okabe (MONACA), arranged for flute (A minor, the vocal line taken an octave higher). The melody builds layer by layer between restraint and surge, moving from a low-voiced telling toward a release of chorus — rewarding practice for laying out breath across long phrases and expressive dynamic shaping.
